claim: A hook that holds interrupts off can lose interrupts while update pace stays in range, so game clock and music run slow; read 'interrupts taken' beside update pace.

evidence.text: A stack wipe under DI lost 6% of the interrupts, so the game's clock and music would have run slow with the update pace in range; interrupts on between the wipe's rows, and shorter plots, brought them back.
evidence.quote: The stack wipe under DI lost 6% of the interrupts, so the game's clock and music would have run slow with the update pace in range.

evidence.text: A turbo limiter running the game frame with interrupts off loses the interrupts a long frame spans; recovered from raster wraps sampled by the hooks and credited to the limiter (verify + 9 unit cases + control; hardware not yet).
